restoration_definition.source: Explicit saved original face IDs, original_source_faces, and C_source_corner_permutations; no score-based C direction selection
restoration_definition.changes: Only first K face rows receive their exact per-face inverse corner permutation; all free face rows unchanged at this stage
restoration_definition.identity: Source face row order and source vertex IDs are explicitly checked, not inferred from coincident coordinates
restoration_definition.coordinates: All vertex-array bytes unchanged; original source C order in existing model coordinates restored exactly
restoration_definition.corner_attributes: Apply the same output-slot-to-input-slot permutation to every saved per-corner attribute; compose subsequent free reversals
restoration_definition.limitations: Changes the old ordered-canonical-C export contract; does not move vertices, certify outward normals/manifoldness, or improve geometric attachment

protocol.C_target: Original source face corner order in the SAME model-coordinate FP32 values; inverse of saved normalization permutation; source selection face order retained
protocol.solver: Existing full indexed two-incidence nondegenerate XOR solver; freeze restored C. Satisfiable components repaired; conflict components unchanged; no deletion/splitting/tuning
protocol.geometry: All vertex bytes, unordered indexed triangles, vertex IDs, face IDs/count, connectivity, free vertex sets unchanged
protocol.attributes: Output corner mappings permuted; old input-domain N-corner audit arrays retained under input_ names, gathered output_ views by source_face_ids/final source_corner_ids. No UV/normal/color attributes present in this panel.
protocol.old_contract: Canonical C ordered bytes preserved at MODEL_POST only; new exports obey separate source-order C contract
protocol.quality: All full CF/FF/I/angle/AVMR/PMR/distance values inherited only after geometry equivalence; cached pair witnesses remain in original corner domain; chosen nearest corner witness remapped explicitly
protocol.partials: Nonmanifold/degenerate/parity/fixed-source-C conflicts reported; no automatic repair beyond registered reversal
protocol.replay: Completed receipt hashes reused; incomplete attempted solve blocks automatic replay
protocol.concurrency: Measure first authorized complete case, then resource-based at most2 CPU workers, two threads per worker; GPU0
protocol.interpretation: Export representation correction, not a new model or new geometric connection
protocol.stop: Fixed36 export/audit/report/package; D0 default unchanged, no automatic commit/push
